events.title: SoFi Technologies, Inc. (SOFI) Matches Q1 Earnings Estimates
events.body: SoFi Technologies (SOFI) delivered earnings and revenue surprises of +1.27% and +4.66%, respectively, for the quarter ended March 2026. Do the numbers hold clues to what lies ahead for the stock?

events.title: PRA Group Q4 Earnings Beat Estimates on Strong Portfolio Income
events.body: PRAA posts Q4 EPS of $1.46, up Y/Y, as cash collections jump 13.6% and portfolio income climbs, topping estimates despite higher costs.
